        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"

            )

            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,

        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"

            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"

        )

        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly

            diff=diff_png,

        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,

        snapshot_root: Path,

        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

        name: str,

        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(

            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,

    def assert_png_matches(

        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"

        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,

            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,

            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",

            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,

        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(

        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,

            artifact_root=artifact_root,

    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)

            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,

        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",

                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,

            raise AssertionError(

            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly

        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)

        if not expected_path.exists():

                name=name,

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(

        png_bytes: bytes,

        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,

            raise AssertionError(

            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()

        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

        if expected == png_bytes:

            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,

        )

        name: str,

        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,

        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()

        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact

        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:

        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,
        png_bytes: bytes,
        *,
        snapshot_root: Path,
        artifact_root: Path,
        update: bool,
        node_id: str,
        source_svg: str | None = None,
        max_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        max_diff_ratio: float | None = None,
        material_diff_threshold: int | None = None,
        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
            raise AssertionError(
                "Missing ACE PNG snapshot golden: "
                f"{expected_path}\n"
                f"Actual PNG written to: {artifacts.actual_path}\n"
                f"Summary written to: {artifacts.summary_path}\n"
                "Re-run with --sase-update-visual-snapshots to accept this "
                "snapshot intentionally."
            )
    
        tolerance = resolve_png_diff_tolerance(
            max_diff_pixels=max_diff_pixels,
            max_diff_ratio=max_diff_ratio,
            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
            expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
            test_file=test_file,
            test_line=test_line,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )

        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""

    def assert_png_matches(
        name: str,

        *,

        update: bool,
        node_id: str,

        max_material_diff_pixels: int | None = None,
        test_file: str | None = None,
        test_line: int | None = None,
        repo_root: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Assert PNG bytes against a committed golden and write diff artifacts."""
        expected_path = snapshot_path(snapshot_root, name)
        expected_repo_path = repo_relative(expected_path, repo_root)
    
        if update:
            write_bytes(expected_path, png_bytes)
            return
    
        if not expected_path.exists():
            artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
                name=name,
                artifact_root=artifact_root,
                node_id=node_id,
                actual=png_bytes,
                expected=None,
                source_svg=source_svg,
                kind="missing_golden",
                expected_repo_path=expected_repo_path,
                test_file=test_file,
                test_line=test_line,

            raise AssertionError(

            material_diff_threshold=material_diff_threshold,
            max_material_diff_pixels=max_material_diff_pixels,
        )
        expected = expected_path.read_bytes()
        # The pinned local renderer emits deterministic PNG bytes. Avoid decoding,
        # compositing, diffing, and re-encoding the overwhelmingly common exact
        # passing case. Byte differences still take the normal pixel-comparison
        # path, so equivalent encodings and every failure artifact behave exactly
        # as before.
        if expected == png_bytes:
            return
        summary, diff_png = diff_pngs(
            expected,
            png_bytes,
            material_diff_threshold=tolerance.material_diff_threshold,
        )
        if tolerance.is_within(summary):
            return
    
        artifacts = write_failure_artifacts(
            name=name,
            artifact_root=artifact_root,
            node_id=node_id,
            actual=png_bytes,
            expected=expected,
            diff=diff_png,
            source_svg=source_svg,
            summary=summary,
            tolerance=tolerance,
            kind="mismatch",
